metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Fran Tufro

plugins.name: skulk
plugins.description: Manage a fleet of remote Claude Code agents over SSH. Full agent lifecycle: create, monitor, interact, review, ship, and clean up.

plugins.name: cubil
plugins.description: Manage markdown-based tasks with cubil. Create, list, show, edit, and move tasks between status folders (backlog, doing, done) from a plain .cubil/ directory in your repo.

plugins.name: husmo
plugins.description: Save and retrieve documents/links through the husmo MCP server: save URLs, pasted text, and local files, triage outgoing links, search by meaning/tag/full-text, and relate documents in a graph.

plugins.name: rust-development
plugins.description: Senior Rust development skills: TDD-disciplined implementation (rust-dev) and structured code review (rust-review).
